The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration has ordered the closure of five food outlets in Mumbai, citing violations of safety norms. Among those shut are Naturals Ice Cream, Bayroute and Miyan Kababs, and four licences have been suspended.

The enforcement sweep also impacted nine Mumbai restaurants, with licences of Chetana, Bayroute and Natural Ice Cream among those withdrawn. In the same operation, the agency seized nutraceuticals worth Rs 1.39 crore that contained NMN and magnesium acetyl taurate.

Separately, Pune’s FDA closed a food supplier linked to Shankar Maharaj Math after identifying hygiene lapses.
